203     @classmethod
204     def to_seed(cls, checked_mnemonic: str, passphrase: str = "") -> bytes:
205         """
206         :param str checked_mnemonic: Must be a correct, fully-expanded BIP39 seed phrase
207         :param str passphrase: Encryption passphrase used to secure the mnemonic
208         :returns bytes: 64 bytes of raw seed material from PRNG
209         """
210         mnemonic = normalize_string(checked_mnemonic)
211         # NOTE: This domain separater ("mnemonic") is added per BIP39 spec
212         # to the passphrase
213         # https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/blob/master/bip-0039.mediawiki#from-mnemonic-to-seed  # noqa: E501
214         salt = "mnemonic" + normalize_string(passphrase)
215         # From BIP39:
216         #   To create a binary seed from the mnemonic, we use the PBKDF2 function with a
217         # mnemonic sentence (in UTF-8 NFKD) used as the password and the string
218         # "mnemonic" and passphrase (again in UTF-8 NFKD) used as the salt.
219         stretched = pbkdf2_hmac_sha512(mnemonic, salt)
220         return stretched[:64]
